# spo_list_design (Data Source)

Look up an existing ListDesign object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The list design description.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `site_scripts` (Set of String) Ordered site-script GUIDs the design runs (at least one is required).
- `title` (String) The list design display name.
